metadata.name: home-launchpad
metadata.description: Stage-4 Home-launchpad journey driving the dual-mode front door end-to-end against the real backend: navigates to / and asserts the launchpad composes — the hero, the universal entry dropzone, and the intent-tile groups all render (the tile groups are built from the static op catalogs, while the recent rail + health chip exercise the live ListJobs and /health queries). It then clicks the 'Crop' Quick-edit tile and asserts the app routes into the unified Workspace (the mode switcher + canvas dropzone appear), proving the Home->Workspace intent handoff (setWorkspaceIntent -> navigate -> Workspace consumes it on mount) works against the live app. A launchpad that fails to compose, a broken tile, or an intent handoff that drops the navigation all fail here. Tile-level intent staging and the recent-rail/Library reopen are unit-covered by HomeLaunchpad.test/workspaceIntent.test.

metadata.label: Routed into the Workspace (mode switcher visible)

assert.failure_message: Workspace canvas dropzone not visible after a Home tile click — the Home->Workspace intent handoff did not land on a working Workspace (check setWorkspaceIntent/takeWorkspaceIntent and the Workspace mount effect).

metadata.label: Assert the Workspace canvas composed (intent handoff complete)
